title: Adhyaya 3: Classical Duties & Dharma
summary: Canonical verses on traditional righteousness from Adhyaya 3.
ai_summary: Exposition of ethical conduct and cosmic law according to Sage Manu in Adhyaya 3.

verses.original: यत्र नार्यस्तु पूज्यन्ते रमन्ते तत्र देवताः । यत्रैतास्तु न पूज्यन्ते सर्वास्तत्राफलाः क्रियाः ॥
verses.transliteration: yatra nāryastu pūjyante ramante tatra devatāḥ | yatraitāstu na pūjyante sarvāstatrāphalāḥ kriyāḥ ||
verses.translation: Where women are honored, there the gods rejoice; but where they are not honored, all sacred rituals become fruitless.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: The foundational ethical mandate declaring that domestic and social well-being requires profound reverence for women.

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: Where women are honored, there the gods rejoice; but where they are not honored, all sacred rituals become fruitless.

layers.author: buhler
layers.author_label: Sacred Books of the East Vol 25
layers.content: मनुस्मृती अध्याय 3: The foundational ethical mandate declaring that domestic and social well-being requires profound reverence for women.

verses.original: शोचन्ति जामयो यत्र विनश्यत्याशु तत्कुलम् । न शोचन्ति तु यत्रैता वर्धते तद्ध सर्वदा ॥
verses.transliteration: śocanti jāmayo yatra vinaśyatyāśu tatkulam | na śocanti tu yatraitā vardhate taddha sarvadā ||
verses.translation: Where the female members of the family grieve in sorrow, that lineage quickly perishes; but where they are joyful, that family forever prospers.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: Domestic harmony and honoring wives, mothers, and daughters protects the continuity of society.

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: Where the female members of the family grieve in sorrow, that lineage quickly perishes; but where they are joyful, that family forever prospers.

layers.author: buhler
